resources.string: How to Play: Guide the falling blocks (Tetrominoes) to create solid horizontal lines. The game ends when a new piece cannot be placed on the board.

Controls: Use the Main FAB (bottom-right) to access controls. The Pause/Play button is visible when controls are closed. In the FAB menu, you can Rotate pieces, move them Left/Right, or speed up their fall with the Down Arrow.

Scoring: Clear lines to score points. Your points are multiplied by your current level, and you level up every 1000 points. Points per line: 1 Line (100), 2 Lines (300), 3 Lines (500), 4 Lines (800 - Tetris!).
